in_sanskrit.name: दीनबन्धु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Friend or companion of the devotee

in_marathi.name: Deenbandhu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Friend of the Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deenbandhu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit words 'deen' meaning 'gods' and 'bandhu' meaning 'friend'. The name Deenbandhu signifies being a friend or companion to the divine beings.

in_bengali.name: Deenbandhu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Friend of the Gods
in_bengali.long_meaning: Deenbandhu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। A name derived from the Sanskrit words 'deen' meaning 'gods' and 'bandhu' meaning 'friend'. The name Deenbandhu signifies being a friend or companion to the divine beings.
